overview.text: Lightspark presents APIs for accounts, cards, payments and fiat or stablecoin money movement for platforms and agents. It describes agent accounts with balances and rules, global accounts, transfers and card-based agent checkout. Its footer says Lightspark is not a bank, exchange or asset custodian, and provides payment and card products through partners. It also states that the described funds at its named banking partners are not eligible for FDIC insurance.
